tools.name: pdfcn_apply_theme
tools.description: Navigate to the Theme Builder with a specific theme pre-loaded. The user can then customize it visually. Returns the URL the browser will navigate to.

tools.name: pdfcn_fetch_registry
tools.description: Fetch the full shadcn registry manifest for pdfcn. Returns all available components, blocks, themes, and utilities with their file structures and dependencies.

tools.name: pdfcn_generate_pdf
tools.description: Generate and download a PDF document. Opens the PDF in a new browser tab for viewing or downloading. Uses the template's default sample data.

block.description: The document template to generate (e.g. invoice-classic)

tools.name: pdfcn_get_block
tools.description: Get the data schema and installation command for a specific PDF template. Use this to understand what data fields are needed to populate the template.

tools.name: pdfcn_get_install_command
tools.description: Get the npx shadcn add command to install a specific pdfcn component or block into the user's project.

component.description: Component or block name (e.g. takumi/text, forme/invoice-classic)

tools.name: pdfcn_get_theme
tools.description: Get the full token details for a specific PDF theme, including all colors, typography, spacing, and page settings.

name.description: The theme preset name to retrieve

tools.name: pdfcn_list_blocks
tools.description: List all available PDF document templates (invoices and reports). Use this to find the right template before generating a PDF.

tools.name: pdfcn_list_docs
tools.description: List all available documentation pages with their paths and descriptions. Use this to discover what documentation is available.

tools.name: pdfcn_list_themes
tools.description: List all available PDF themes with their color palettes, typography, and page settings. Use this to discover themes before applying one.

tools.name: pdfcn_open_docs
tools.description: Navigate to a pdfcn documentation page. Use this to learn about components, theming, installation, or any other topic.

path.description: Documentation path (e.g. /docs/installation, /docs/components). If omitted, opens the main docs page.

tools.name: pdfcn_preview_block
tools.description: Open a PDF preview for a template in a new browser tab. The preview uses sample data and the current theme.

tools.name: pdfcn_search_components
tools.description: Search the pdfcn component registry by name or description. Returns matching components, blocks, themes, and utilities with install commands.

query.description: Search query (fuzzy match against component names and descriptions)
